title: Luxuriant Scottish Pork Belly Grill
description: A pungent and springy solo dinner dish featuring pork belly slices, this Scottish recipe is perfect for a night in, cooked to perfection in a cazuela and served hot.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, garlic, brown sugar, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Place the pork belly slices in a large cazuela and brush the mixture from the bowl evenly over both sides of the pork.
Place the cazuela on the grill and cook the pork belly for 5 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 160 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the pork is cooking, mix the apple cider vinegar and water in a small bowl.
After flipping the pork, brush the apple cider vinegar mixture over the top of the pork belly slices.
Once the pork is cooked, remove it from the grill and let it rest for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the pork belly slices hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
